summary: Major JLPT pipeline overhaul: migrated from flat 100-word N5 vocab list to full Minna no Nihongo (MNN) Shokyu I curriculum. Fixed day-counter inflation bug for unanswered lessons and updated the jlpt-tutor skill to match the new pipeline architecture. Began N4 content assessment — MNN Shokyu II PDF identified as image-only, requiring OCR before extraction.
highlights: Built extract_mnn.py to parse 25 MNN Shokyu I lessons from PDF → mnn_content.json (619 words); produced word_bank.json (594 words, lesson-tagged), grammar_bank.json (46 patterns), mnn_tracker.json curriculum engine, mnn_lesson_selector.py, and update_mnn_tracker.py

Fixed unanswered-lesson guard in jlpt_pipeline.sh: detects when lesson was sent but never answered (last_session_date ≠ yesterday), re-generates same lesson with same word IDs without incrementing progress.day
Updated jlpt-tutor skill: syncs mnn_tracker.json, reads gate/tier2 state, archives session with mnn_lesson/session_type/gate_result fields, explicitly gates progress.day increment to pipeline only
Resolved git conflict that wiped new scripts during a pull-during-push race: reinstalled pymupdf, regenerated all data files from scratch, force-pushed (commit df76e6c)
Assessed MNN Shokyu II PDF for N4 expansion: confirmed fully image-based (Images2PDF), verified vocabulary page format via vision_analyze — OCR extraction path required before pipeline append
